role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 只要翱翔于天空，蝙蝠骑士可以从四面八方发动攻势。他手握拉索把敌人抓住，从树梢高飞而过，将猎物从一道火焰路径上拖到无情的盟友面前。
hero_summary_en: Once he takes to the skies, Batrider can strike from any direction. Snatching a foe with his lasso, he soars above the treetops, pulling his prey through a trail of flame as he drags them before his merciless allies.

abilities.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
abilities.description_zh: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
abilities.description_en: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
notes_zh: 所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。
notes_en: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.

shard_loc.en: Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
shard_loc.zh: 粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Sticky Napalm. Level %max_level_tooltip% Sticky Napalm causes every attack to apply %napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip% stack of Sticky Napalm.
facet_text_zh: 提升粘性燃油的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级粘性燃油会使每次攻击施加%napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip%层粘性燃油。

abilities.name: batrider_flamebreak
abilities.description_zh: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: batrider_firefly
abilities.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
abilities.description_en: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
notes_zh: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。
notes_en: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
facet_text_en: Firefly also lights Batrider on fire. He gains increasingly more Move Speed and burns away a portion of his max health each second. Maximum bonuses are reached at the end of Firefly's duration. Self-burn damage is constant and does not increase over time.
facet_text_zh: 火焰飞行还会使蝙蝠骑士着火。他每秒会被烧灼一定百分比的最大生命值，但是移动速度会逐渐大幅提升。对自身的烧灼伤害恒定，不会逐渐增加。

abilities.name: batrider_smoldering_resin
abilities.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每%tick_rate%秒造成%tick_attack_damage_pct%%%攻击伤害，持续%total_ticks%秒。
abilities.description_en: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals %tick_attack_damage_pct%%% of the attack damage every %tick_rate%s for %total_ticks%s.

abilities.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
abilities.description_zh: 用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
abilities.description_en: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
notes_zh: 杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。
notes_en: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.

scepter_loc.en: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
scepter_loc.zh: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近%grab_radius_scepter%范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

talents_raw.name_loc: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm
